extracted.intended_audience: arXiv developers and moderators implementing submission & moderation automation
extracted.subtask_description: Documentation of system behaviours for proposing and accepting category cross-lists and reclassifications within the arXiv submission & moderation pipeline. Covers classes/methods that generate and accept automated classification proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: AcceptSystemCrossListProposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Accept any cross-list proposals generated by the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accept pending system proposals for cross-list classification. (Note in docs: 'This is a bit odd, since we likely generated the proposal in this very thread… but this seems to be an explicit feature of the classic system.') Method: accept(previous, trigger, emit). Return type: None.

rubrics_metrics.name: ProposeCrossListFromPrimaryCategory
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose a cross-list classification based on primary classification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the proposal via propose(previous, trigger, emit). Return type: None.

rubrics_metrics.name: ProposeReclassification
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate system classification proposals based on classifier results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides mechanisms to create reclassification proposals; contains method propose_primary to propose a new primary classification when appropriate. Method: propose_primary(previous, trigger, emit) — 'Propose a new primary classification, if appropriate.' Return type: None.

rubrics_metrics.name: propose_primary (within ProposeReclassification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose a new primary classification, if appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invoked as part of ProposeReclassification to change a submission's primary category when classifier output indicates a different primary classification. Signature: propose_primary(previous, trigger, emit). Return type: None.
